privacy: Privacy Policy

Effective Date: October 2026

payment, or use transportation, transfer or related services provided by GoLuxTrip.

By using our website or providing information to us in connection with a service request or 
booking, you acknowledge the practices described in this Privacy Policy.

Depending on how you interact with GoLuxTrip, we may collect information including:

For corporate clients, we may also process business contact information relating to employees,

A person or organization making a reservation may provide information concerning other

The person making the booking is responsible for ensuring that they are authorized to provide 
information reasonably necessary for GoLuxTrip to arrange the requested transportation.

We use such information only as reasonably necessary to organize and provide the service and

GoLuxTrip may use its own available resources or engage independent drivers and contracted

6. Payments and Payment Links

GoLuxTrip may provide clients with E-POS or other secure payment links for payment of

Card transactions may be processed by our acquiring bank, payment system or other authorized

Where payment is processed through a third-party payment system, payment-card information is

GoLuxTrip may receive transaction-related information such as payment status, transaction

We do not intentionally request clients to send full bank-card numbers, CVV/CVC security

We do not sell personal information.

Where a payment dispute, suspected fraud or chargeback occurs, GoLuxTrip may use and 
disclose relevant records to the acquiring bank, card network, payment provider or other 
authorized institution.

Such information may include the applicable quotation, booking confirmation, invoice, payment 
record, client communications, cancellation information and reasonable evidence relating to 
provision of the transportation service.

This information is used for legitimate payment verification, fraud prevention and dispute-
resolution purposes.

When you visit GoLuxTrip.com, certain technical information may be collected automatically by

This information may be used for website operation, security, troubleshooting, performance

GoLuxTrip.com may use cookies or similar technologies that are necessary for website 
functionality, security, performance and, where applicable, analytics.

Where required by applicable law, visitors will be provided with appropriate information or 
choices concerning non-essential cookies.

Users may also be able to manage cookies through their browser settings. Disabling certain 
cookies may affect some website functionality.
11. Data Security

GoLuxTrip takes reasonable organizational and technical measures designed to protect personal 
information against unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, loss or misuse.

Access to personal information should be limited to personnel and service providers who 
reasonably require the information for their work or for fulfillment of the requested service.

However, no electronic transmission or information-storage system can be guaranteed to be 
completely secure.

We retain personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes for

Retention periods may therefore differ depending on the type of information and the purpose for

When information is no longer reasonably required, it may be deleted, anonymized or securely 
disposed of in accordance with applicable requirements.
13. International Processing and Service Providers

Some technology, communication or other service providers used in connection with 
GoLuxTrip's operations may process information using systems located outside the Republic of 
Uzbekistan.

Where personal information is stored, transferred or processed outside Uzbekistan, GoLuxTrip

GoLuxTrip will not knowingly transfer personal information internationally in a manner 
prohibited by applicable law.

15. Children's Information

GoLuxTrip provides transportation services that may include children travelling with parents, 
guardians, organizations or other authorized persons.

Where information about a child is reasonably necessary to arrange transportation—for example, 
information required for an appropriate child seat—we expect such information to be provided 
by the child's parent, guardian or another person authorized to arrange the transportation.

We do not knowingly collect information from children directly for independent marketing 
purposes.
16. Marketing Communications

Where permitted by applicable law, GoLuxTrip may use client contact information to 
communicate information about relevant services or offers.

Where consent is required, marketing communications will be sent on the appropriate consent

Recipients may request that direct marketing communications stop at any time using the

A request to stop marketing communications does not prevent us from sending necessary

GoLuxTrip.com may contain links to third-party websites or services.

GoLuxTrip is not responsible for the privacy practices, content or security of independent third-
party websites. Visitors should review the privacy policies of those services before providing 
personal information to them.
18. Legal Requirements

GoLuxTrip may collect, retain, use or disclose information where reasonably necessary to 
comply with applicable legislation, lawful governmental requests, court orders, regulatory 
requirements or other legally binding obligations.

Nothing in this Privacy Policy is intended to limit rights granted to individuals under mandatory 
applicable data-protection law.
19. Changes to This Privacy Policy

GoLuxTrip may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our services, 
technologies, business practices or applicable legal requirements.
The updated version will be published on GoLuxTrip.com with a revised effective date.
Material changes will apply prospectively unless otherwise required by applicable law.

Unless expressly stated otherwise, a quotation applies only to the itinerary and requirements

Prices may change before booking confirmation if there is a change in availability, route, dates,

Once a booking has been confirmed and paid, GoLuxTrip will not change the confirmed price

requests or causes changes to the agreed service.

Any quotation may have an indicated validity period. If no validity period is stated, availability 
and price remain subject to confirmation until payment and booking confirmation.

A client's request or receipt of a quotation does not by itself guarantee vehicle or driver 
availability.
After the client accepts the quotation, GoLuxTrip may issue an invoice or secure payment link.
Unless otherwise agreed in writing, a reservation becomes confirmed only after:

Payment must be made using a payment method authorized by GoLuxTrip.

Clients are responsible for ensuring that payment information is accurate and that they are

Payments made through E-POS or a payment link are processed through the applicable bank,

GoLuxTrip may refuse or temporarily suspend confirmation of a transaction where payment

The client is responsible for providing complete and accurate information necessary to perform

The client must notify GoLuxTrip in advance of requirements that may affect the vehicle or

GoLuxTrip is not responsible for delays, additional costs or inability to perform the service

6. Pickup, Waiting Time and No-Shows

Clients are responsible for being available at the confirmed pickup location at the confirmed

Reasonable waiting time may be included depending on the service and quotation. Additional

For airport and railway transfers, GoLuxTrip will make reasonable efforts to take known arrival

A client may be considered a no-show where the passenger cannot be located or contacted 
within the applicable waiting period and has not informed GoLuxTrip of the delay.
No-shows are subject to the applicable Cancellation & Refund Policy.
7. Changes to a Confirmed Service

Requests to change the date, pickup time, route, destination, passenger count, vehicle type,

Any additional cost resulting from a requested change will be communicated to the client where

GoLuxTrip will make reasonable efforts to provide the vehicle category confirmed in the

Vehicle photographs, models or examples displayed on our website, quotation or promotional

Where necessary because of operational circumstances, maintenance, breakdown, availability,

If only a materially different or lower-category vehicle is available, GoLuxTrip will seek to

9. Drivers and Safety

Drivers are expected to comply with applicable road-safety requirements and may refuse any 
instruction that they reasonably believe would violate traffic regulations, licensing requirements

Clients must not request drivers to speed, violate traffic regulations, exceed lawful vehicle 
capacity or operate in unsafe conditions.

The driver or GoLuxTrip may refuse to continue transportation where passenger conduct creates 
a material safety risk to the driver, passengers, vehicle or third parties.
10. Passenger Conduct
Passengers must behave responsibly and must not damage, contaminate or misuse the vehicle.
Smoking is prohibited in vehicles unless expressly permitted.

Passengers must not carry illegal substances, prohibited items, dangerous materials or property 
whose transportation is unlawful.

The client may be responsible for reasonable cleaning, repair or replacement costs resulting from

GoLuxTrip may refuse or discontinue service where a passenger behaves violently, abusively, 
unlawfully or in a manner that creates a genuine safety risk.
11. Luggage and Personal Property

Clients are responsible for ensuring that the quantity and size of luggage are appropriate for the

GoLuxTrip should be informed in advance about oversized or unusual baggage.

Passengers remain responsible for their personal belongings before, during and after

GoLuxTrip will make reasonable efforts to assist with property found in a vehicle but does not

Pickup times, journey durations and arrival estimates may be affected by circumstances outside

Estimated journey or arrival times are therefore not guarantees unless expressly agreed

13. Breakdown and Operational Disruption

In the event of a vehicle breakdown, accident or other operational problem, GoLuxTrip will

Approved card-payment refunds will ordinarily be returned through the applicable payment

15. Corporate, Group and Special Services

Transportation for delegations, events, field missions, multi-day assignments, large groups,

Such services may therefore be subject to specific payment, cancellation, overtime,

To fulfill certain reservations, GoLuxTrip may engage independent drivers or third-party

Such providers may operate their own vehicles and employ or engage their own personnel.

cancellation: Cancellation & Refund Policy

GOLUXTRIP LLC 
Effective Date: October 2026

This Cancellation & Refund Policy applies to transportation, transfer and logistics services 
booked and paid for directly with GOLUXTRIP LLC.
1. Booking and Payment

Upon receiving a transportation or logistics request, GOLUXTRIP provides the client with a 
quotation based on the requested route, vehicle type, service date and time, duration, and other 
service requirements.

Once the client accepts the quotation and confirms the requested service and price, GOLUXTRIP 
may send a secure payment link to complete the reservation.

A booking is considered confirmed once the required payment has been successfully completed 
and the reservation has been confirmed by GOLUXTRIP. Following confirmation, the required 
vehicle, driver and other necessary transportation resources are reserved for the client.
2. Cancellation by the Client
Clients may cancel a confirmed reservation before the scheduled service start time.

Unless different cancellation conditions are clearly stated in the quotation or service agreement 
before payment, the following standard cancellation policy applies:

Cancellation time is calculated from the confirmed pickup or service start time.
3. Refund Procedure

If a cancellation qualifies for a full or partial refund, the applicable cancellation fee will be 
deducted from the total amount paid and the remaining balance will be refunded to the client.

For payments made by bank card through E-POS/payment link, the applicable refund or 
cancellation of the payment transaction will be processed through the payment system and the 
refundable amount will be returned to the same bank card used for the original payment.

Approved refunds will be initiated by GOLUXTRIP within 10 business days after the 
cancellation and refund amount have been confirmed.

After GOLUXTRIP initiates the refund, the actual time required for the funds to appear on the 
client's card or account may additionally depend on the acquiring bank, payment system and 
card-issuing bank.

GOLUXTRIP does not issue card-payment refunds in cash or transfer refundable amounts to a 
different bank card or third party, except where otherwise required by applicable law or agreed in 
accordance with the applicable payment rules.
4. Changes and Rescheduling

Clients may request changes to the pickup date or time, route, vehicle type or other reservation 
details. All changes are subject to vehicle and driver availability.

GOLUXTRIP will make reasonable efforts to accommodate requested changes. If a modification 
results in additional operational or transportation costs, the client will be informed of the 
additional amount before the change is confirmed.
5. Cancellation by GOLUXTRIP

If GOLUXTRIP is unable to provide a confirmed transportation service and cannot offer a 
suitable alternative acceptable to the client, the client will receive a 100% refund of the amount 
paid for the affected service.
6. Corporate, Group and Special Transportation

Corporate events, delegations, field missions, multi-day transportation, buses, minibuses, 
multiple-vehicle reservations and other services requiring special advance arrangements may be 
subject to different cancellation conditions.

Where different conditions apply, they will be clearly communicated to the client in the 
quotation or service agreement before payment is made.
7. How to Request a Cancellation or Refund

To cancel or modify a reservation, clients should contact GOLUXTRIP using the contact details 
provided in their quotation, invoice, booking confirmation or on our official website.
The request should include:

• 
Client or company name; 
• 
Booking, quotation or invoice reference; 
• 
Scheduled service date and time; and 
• 
Details of the requested cancellation or modification.

The cancellation request will be considered received when it is received by GOLUXTRIP 
through an official communication channel.
